name: Solitaire
description: Classic seven-column patience in a panel, to play while Claude works. Tap a card and it goes where it fits, or drag it to choose; Draw 1 or Draw 3, unlimited undo, a Finish button once every card is face up, and games won and best time per draw mode. Cards scale with the panel, suit symbols are always shown and a four-colour deck is a setting. When a Claude tab of the window finishes and waits for you, the game pauses and names that tab, with a button to go to it. Reads only the window's tab statuses; never types into a session, runs nothing and uses no network.
author: BronOS
